name: Mirror Linear tasks to Todoist
description: When a Linear issue is assigned to me, create a matching task in my Todoist.

triggers.description: Runs when a Linear issue is created and assigned to me

steps.title: Create Todoist task
steps.description: Creates a matching task in my Todoist inbox with a link back to the Linear issue.
steps.prompt:
Call mcp.todoist['add-tasks'] once, to create one task in the user's Inbox (projectId "inbox") that mirrors the Linear issue that was just created:

- content: `` trigger.payload.issue.title ``
- description: exactly "[" + `` trigger.payload.issue.identifier `` + "](" + `` trigger.payload.issue.url `` + ")", with nothing before or after it. "Complete Linear task from Todoist" reads the issue from this link, so its format must not change.

Set nothing else: no due date, priority or labels.

steps.title: Summarize result
steps.description: Build a short summary of the mirrored task.
